messages:
mira.pm: Quick sync: I'm consolidating the Private Deploy roadmap items into a single delivery contract focused on installer guarantees (VPC + air-gapped). Need SRE, docs, and sales to sanity check upgrade promises and installer modes.

ash.sre: High level we should promise three upgrade classes (hotfix, minor, major) with clearly scoped disruption windows. Also define a hard network contract so field engineers know what to expect.

zoe.docs: For airgap bundles we need signed manifests, an offline verifier CLI, and a support bundle command that collects signed logs + manifest hash. I'll draft docs snippets.

pavan.sales: Customers keep asking for IP immutability during upgrades. If we can offer an "IP-preserve" installer mode that's enterprise-default, it'll unblock deals. Include language about port maps and NAT behavior.

jorge.eng: Implementation note: `--preserve-ips` will skip interface reprovisioning and keep existing route tables. We should add an installer dry-run that outputs a delta plan so netops can review pre-apply.

ash.sre: Add a runtime readiness gate: runtime/ready + kv/migration/ok endpoints. We should refuse traffic shift until kv namespaces report consistent versions. Default drain timeout 300s but configurable per deployment.

mira.pm: Draft launch gates I'm thinking: preflight pass, signed network contract accepted, dry-run validated by customer, canary subnet test (1216h), rollback verified. Thoughts on canary window?

pavan.sales: For sales frictions shorter windows are better, but Ops ask for 24h. Maybe make canary window configurable; recommend 24h default for regulated customers.

zoe.docs: UX: propose CLI flags `--preserve-ips`, `--manifest ./bundle.sig`, `--dry-run`, `--escalate-on-failure`. Include example output for delta plan and a troubleshooting subsection for overlapping-CIDR, multi-NIC, and external-LB SNAT.

jorge.eng: Edge cases: VPN tunnels that rewrite source IPs, NAT64 proxies, and ephemeral public IP pools. I'll add detection heuristics in preflight and explicit failure modes in the dry-run.

ash.sre: Also add an install-time option to create a signed escapepod (support-only VM) so we can fetch logs from airgapped sites if customer permits. Documented opt-in.

mira.pm: Action items: Zoe -> CLI examples and support-bundle doc; Jorge -> dry-run delta plan + preflight checks; Ash -> readiness gate and health-hook spec; Pavan -> validate enterprise language with two buyers. I'll fold into RFC and aim to cut PR by next Tue.

ship-bot: [ship-bot] created: /rfc/private-deploy/contracts/installer-contracts-draft.md

mira.pm: Post any other corner cases here (overlapping tenant CIDRs, 3rd-party LBs, host firewall rules) before EOD Friday. Thanks!
